why: Pricing API. Tax needs region from customer (pass region string to tax). Invoice gets item/customer via pricing and passes region to tax; tax owns rules.

functions.compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct=: lines: iterable of (category: str, amount_cents: int) pairs. region: region code str (e.g. TX) or None for an unknown customer (0% tax). discount_pct: customer discount in percent (e.g. 10). Returns sales tax in integer cents. Only lines whose category is not exempt count toward the taxable amount; the discount is applied to the taxable amount; the final tax is rounded half-up to the cent once.
functions.tax_pct(region) -> float: rate in percent from data_tax/rates.csv; None -> 0.0; a region string not in rates.csv raises KeyError
functions.is_exempt(category) -> bool: True if category is listed in data_tax/exempt_categories.csv

why: Proposed tax.py API. invoice.py calls compute_tax(...) with (category, amount_cents) pairs and does not apply tax rules itself. pricing.py supplies region (None if unknown) and discount_pct.
